items.task: Second independent verifier for gate KB-G3 of the knowledge base (the first: tracks/kb/stage/KB-G3/VERIFIER.md, read only its list of what it covered). Fresh reader, own code, predictions first, registered runs, the snapshot db/current. (1) The claims written or changed since the first verifier (packages claims3 and the lead's sessions: 862 to 881, the superseded and withdrawn ones, seeds 803 and 805, 409, 447, 449, 450, 452, 781, 804, 714, 809): each re-read at its locators in the store: supported as worded, not supported, or locator wrong. (2) A new stratified sample of forty claims from the whole store with a seed committed before the draw (strata: checked by a person, located by machine, the weak class of claims3): the rate right as worded per stratum with its interval, and whether the package states the limit of the machine-located claims honestly. (3) The criteria of KB-G3 in coord/CHARTER.md section 'Gates of the knowledge base', one by one, against the package tracks/kb/stage/KB-G3/: met, not met, with the evidence. tracks/kb/stage/KB-G3/VERIFIER2.md: what was checked and how, per item the verdict, what could not be checked, the three weakest points, and a recommendation (pass, pass with reservations, not yet).
